name: Long-rollout gradient pathologies
summary: Gradient health when you differentiate through a long rollout. Arguably the central difficulty of differentiable simulation, since the gradient is a product of many per-step Jacobians.

tasks.title: Root-cause and fix the long-rollout NaN
Softened wall contact for smooth boundary gradients
tasks.note: The hard wall clamp is a non-smooth kink in the gradient. Replace it with a smooth ramp and measure whether gradient quality improves, independent of the (already-fixed) mass overflow. Tests the contact-differentiability hypothesis directly.

tasks.title: Gradient memory and throughput vs resolution
tasks.note: How do grid and particle counts trade against GPU throughput and the memory of the stored backward tape? Maps the practical envelope of what is differentiable, at what cost.
